decisions.design_decisions_empty: The brief carries design_decisions = {} and added_assumptions = []. All scope calls below are F1's own and are recorded here rather than silently applied.
decisions.persistent_hypothesis_structure: Revision sync: every direct assumption dependency of a minimax statement is realized as a universally quantified implication from membership in the exact class or slice occurring inside that statement's risk/honesty/value definitions. Standing scalar-domain conditions remain separate. No theorem binds a single model-class witness, and no named assumption atom is replaced by a loose copy of its scalar content.
decisions.full_data_coordinate_space: D-A. The full-data law P_n^F is encoded as a probability Measure on the EXPLICIT coordinate space Bool x X x Bool x Bool x R x R = (S, X, D(0), D(1), Y(0), Y(1)), not through Causalean.PO's POSystem/POIVSystem. Justification (bypass-justified): Causalean.PO is a variable-indexed, regime-indexed skeleton (Regime/POSystem/ValuesOn, several members still `sorry`) with no population indicator S and no transport layer; the note's proofs are direct computations on the joint coordinate law, and the fixed-geometry witness must be CONSTRUCTED explicitly and verified against every causal assumption, which is far cheaper on a coordinate space. Causalean.PO.ID.Exact.LATE is retained as the ANALOGOUS module: its first_stage_identity / reduced_form_identity / pointwise_monotonicity / event_conditioning_identity / late_wald chain is exactly the proof pattern prop:compact-causal-range adapts (gap to bridge: two populations + transport weight + the E_S[w h(X)] = E_T[h(X)] change of measure).
decisions.procedure_encoding: D-B. A confidence-set sequence C_n is encoded as a bundled structure carrying (i) the set map, (ii) `subset : forall s, set s subset Theta`, and (iii) sample-by-parameter graph measurability. For `OracleProcedure`, the oracle weight and propensity are fixed deterministic inputs: `measurableGraph` quantifies over each fixed measurable `(w,e)`, while `weightAEInvariant` identifies, almost surely under each in-class row's two-sample law, evaluations at measurable nonnegative weight versions equal source-law almost everywhere. Thus the paper's a.e.-defined w is a law-indexed quotient input and honesty/risk quantify over P only. For regular cells, `RegularCellInput` bundles the true support embedding and Fin (k_n)-indexed q/e vectors, so procedures may use the full known vectors without a universal comparison across alternative supports or arbitrary ambient extensions.
decisions.risk_as_bounded_isup_ilimsup: D-C. frontierRisk / oracleValue / finiteCellOracleValue / fixedGeometryValue are `limsup` of a bounded `iSup` over a subtype of in-class laws, then `iInf` over a subtype of honest procedure sequences -- the same inf-sup shape as Causalean.Estimation.MinimaxATE.Model.minimaxMiss. Boundedness (lambda(C_n) <= 2 on Theta = [-1,1]) makes every sup/inf well defined without side conditions.
decisions.triangular_array: D-D. A member of P_n is a SEQUENCE-indexed object: the class predicate is stated at index n over an array (P_n^F, e)_{n>=1} together with the array-level conditions (ass:degrading-array, ass:two-sample-array's N_n/n -> c). The Lean class structures therefore take the whole array plus the index-n data, matching the core's `at index n` phrasing.
decisions.finite_cell_carrier_sync: Redirect sync under the persistent arbitrary-carrier rule: every finite and regular experiment remains polymorphic over one fixed measurable carrier X. At row n, FiniteCellSource supplies measurable atoms cell : Fin (k_n) ↪ X and requires the source law to equal finiteUniformCellLaw cell, the explicit uniform pushforward of the discrete Fin (k_n) experiment. Thus the row law is carrier-exhausted by exactly those k_n cells and all ambient points outside the image are null, without the forbidden growing equivalence Fin (k_n) ≃ X. Uniform/regular procedure, honesty, risk, and value layers retain the same arbitrary carrier. Finite/regular statements use hCarrier : forall n, exists cell : Fin (k n) ↪ X, forall i, MeasurableSet {cell i}; witness lemmas prove class inhabitation from it. No theorem, class argument, or value is specialized to Nat.
decisions.no_cited_nodes: Every statement node carries status:"proved"; there is no status:"cited" node, hence no cite:<slug> is minted and citations is empty. The bibliography entries are comparators (all `unmatched / downgraded_to_informed_by` in the comparator table), not assumed interfaces.
decisions.no_oeq_nodes: The core carries no `oeq:` / openendedquestion node (the two attainment questions from the proposal were resolved into thm:oracle-score-inversion-attainment, thm:finite-cell-unknown-weight-attainment and thm:regular-cell-unknown-weight-attainment during D0). No node is mapped to a stated-only Prop.
decisions.assumption_classification: All 16 `ass:` nodes were classified. Every one is a MODELING assumption (a restriction on the data law / design / transport geometry / array rates): support and population presence, the two-sample sampling design, instrument positivity, source assignment+consistency, the three IV restrictions, the two transport restrictions, target complier positivity, transport domination, the weight envelope and second-moment cap, the degrading-array rates, and the finite-cell design. NONE is a substrate fact (no concentration / information / orthogonality inequality is stated as an assumption in this core), so no assumption is discharged against Causalean and none is escalated. Every one stays a threaded Prop hypothesis, consumed inline or bundled by def:model-class / def:finite-cell-class.
decisions.no_defer_tier: No node is Defer. The two heavy items are (a) the fixed-geometry continuum witness + its chi-square/TV calibration and (b) the regular-cell collision U-statistic variance bound. Both are elementary probability. (a) has the exact reusable substrate present in Causalean (Stat/Minimax chi-square tensorization + Scheffe/Cauchy-Schwarz TV bound). (b) is NOT a direct reuse: the collision kernel is symmetric but nondegenerate, so Causalean's DegenKernel-only second-moment theorems do not apply to it; the plan instead reuses the Stat/UStatistic/Basic Hoeffding-centering layer (hoeffding_decomp / uProj / uDegen), proves the projection term locally as a plain i.i.d. variance, and applies the degenerate lemmas only to the centered remainder -- with the note's own direct overlapping-pair expansion as an equally local fallback (see the thm:regular-cell-unknown-weight-attainment node). Both also have a direct in-repo analogue in CausalSmith (STAT_DoseResponseMinimax_Research two-point witness; STAT_DiscreteAteMinimaxLoggap_Research multinomial/factorial moments). Size is not openness: they are build-inline, in scope.
decisions.file_layout: 7 statements => one T_*.lean per statement + Basic.lean (worlds, 16 assumption Props, the two class structures, the geometry/slice/regular-cell defs) + Frontier.lean (procedure/honesty/risk/value layer) + a Helpers/ chain split by topic (Witness, Divergence, ExpectedLength, ScoreInversion, CellEstimators, RateAlgebra) rather than one Helpers.lean.
decisions.substrate_survey_bypass_justified: Surveyed and NOT reused verbatim, with reason: (1) Causalean.PO / PO.ID.Exact.LATE -- different abstraction (regime/variable-indexed skeleton, no S, no transport), see D-A; used as analogous proof pattern. (2) Causalean.Estimation.MinimaxATE -- finite-PMF ATE two-point model (Obs = Fin M x Bool x Bool, minimaxMiss over quantile risk); our risk is honest EXPECTED SET LENGTH over a general covariate space with a two-sample design, so the Model layer cannot be reused verbatim; its inf-sup packaging shape is copied. (3) Causalean.PO.ID.Partial.Inference.Basic -- coverage vocabulary (RandomCoversPoint / honest_ci_set_cover) is for a FIXED interval-identified parameter with plug-in half-widths, not for an inf over honest procedure SEQUENCES with a limsup risk; not reusable, recorded as the nearest coverage vocabulary. (4) Causalean.Stat.Minimax.{TotalVariation,Scheffe,ChiSquared,ChiSquaredFinite,MinimaxRisk,LeCam} -- REUSED (see per-node reuse fields). (5) Causalean.Stat.{Sample,Sample.PiTransport} -- REUSED for the i.i.d. product-law primitives. (6) Causalean.Stat.UStatistic.Basic -- REUSED (hoeffding_decomp / uMean / uProj / uDegen / uProj_integral_eq_zero / uProj_integrable / uDegen_integral_right_eq_zero) to center the collision kernel. (7) Causalean.Stat.UStatistic.Variance -- PARTIALLY reused: integral_offDiag_sum_sq / integral_rescaled_sq are applied ONLY to the centered degenerate remainder uDegen, never to the collision kernel itself, whose first projection w(x) = p_x/q_{x,n} is nonzero (bypass-justified for the raw kernel: the DegenKernel `deg` field fails). (8) Causalean.Stat.UStatistic.OrderM.{Variance,ExactVariance} -- NOT reused (bypass-justified): the order-m ExactVariance layer is likewise stated for OrderDegenKernel, and the order-2 file already covers the remainder, so importing it would add a hypothesis burden with no gain. The projection term and, if the IIDSample-indexing bridge proves awkward, the whole variance bound stay local in Helpers/CellEstimators.lean.
